question.text: Merchant Banker's role in primary market:

answer.text: Manage public issue, due diligence, pricing, underwriting

explanation.text: The Logic: MB = lead manager for IPOs — due diligence, pricing, allotment, post-issue compliance. The Trap: Broker is secondary-market role. Cross-Exam Context: IX (Merchant Banking). Manager's Pro-Tip: MB-led IPO quality varies — review track record of green-shoe use, post-issue performance.
